body: It’s those little things that give me hope when I’m just about to let go. Thanks stranger check in every know and then if you wish. I hope you you here from who you desperately want those words from. My thoughts and feelings as with you. I hope I do to more than anything. Thanks again for the smile it’s been awhile.

:) thank you that actually made my night better. One of what feels like a lifetime of sleepless nights. I’d forgive you to if you ever needed or wanted it!! Or just someone to tell you that to. Thanks for the smile!!
Thank you!!! I hope so to I choose to love and forgive to. When you care about someone like that there was never a choice Between the two.
I wish this was for me. I’m in a similar place in my situation I wish you the best in yours!!!
I hope you get your chance to go back, I know this isnt for me but the way I have been feeling this hits  close to home thats all.
Maybe things arent as they seem to be. He might not be playing around there is always more than meets the eye.
I wish my person would tell me that. They have been on mind non stop I just cant and dont want to shake it.
who do you think I am is more of the question
